points.point: Why the same video fails on Bluesky when it worked on X
Whether a signed storage URL with no file extension is accepted for Bluesky

verdict.reason: No single entry explains why this video fails on Bluesky but works on X: the Bluesky entry only lists the 4-image/1-video limit and a generic "confirm every media URL is public and uses a supported format," which does not say whether a signed URL without an extension is accepted, and the other entries cover different errors or platforms, so this needs a human to check the failed post.
